metric_definitions.analyzed_fps: sampled frames divided by evaluated media duration; not wall-clock render FPS
metric_definitions.valid_face_frame_ratio: frames containing exactly one face and valid landmarks divided by analyzed frames
metric_definitions.dropout_run: contiguous analyzed frames without a valid single-face landmark track
metric_definitions.reacquisition_seconds: time from the first invalid frame in a bracketed dropout to the next valid frame
metric_definitions.landmark_jitter: frame-to-frame RMS movement of rigid landmarks after eye-line alignment and inter-eye normalization, only in stable runs
metric_definitions.multi_face_abstention: frames with more than one detected face must expose no landmarks to downstream scoring
